comparison.objective: Candidate performs open-carton rejection on a live belt; PR-1871 copies an irregular wall profile onto a shelf with a compass.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests dynamic tracking, collision-aware grasping and level transport. PR-1871 tests stabilizing a workpiece while maintaining point-wall and pencil-board contact along a continuous path.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires correct routing, no spill, released tray dwell and untouched normal cartons. PR-1871 requires a continuous curved line meeting station tolerances, tool set-down and no excessive shelf movement.
comparison.reason: Continuous contact tracing and geometric mark accuracy are materially different from moving-container handling. No material rubric detail is missing.
